finding.conclusion: The FastVolt charger inventory is not serialized into the initial /carte HTML or its initial Next Flight payload. The chargerMap component receives a client-side chargers prop, so the producer must be a client-side request/state/data path or a later navigation/data fetch rather than the initial server-rendered page payload.
finding.blocker: Trace the client-side producer of the chargers prop from public same-origin assets; do not guess station endpoints.

tcc_modeling.status_source: FastVolt native only when the charger feed is validated

next_safe_step: Statically trace assignments/data hooks feeding the chargerMap chargers prop in public bundles and inspect only literal public request targets or later same-origin read-only data calls justified by those assets.
